name: obsidian-second-brain
description: AI-powered knowledge compilation engine for Obsidian

scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.release: npm run build && rm -f second-brain.zip && BUILD_DIR=$(pwd) && cd /tmp && rm -rf second-brain second-brain.zip && mkdir -p second-brain/.obsidian/plugins/second-brain && cp "$BUILD_DIR"/main.js "$BUILD_DIR"/manifest.json "$BUILD_DIR"/styles.css second-brain/.obsidian/plugins/second-brain/ && cp -r "$BUILD_DIR"/raw-sample second-brain/raw && cd second-brain && zip -r "$BUILD_DIR"/second-brain.zip . && cd /tmp && rm -rf second-brain && echo "Done: $BUILD_DIR/second-brain.zip"
